faqs.question: How many pieces do I need for a practical office capsule wardrobe?
faqs.answer: A small set of mix-and-match basics—tailored layers, versatile bottoms, comfortable work shoes, and a structured bag—can cover most weekdays and evening plans without overbuying.

faqs.question: What footwear works best for Indian office commutes?
faqs.answer: Comfort-first options with good cushioning (like supportive loafers, slingbacks, or clean court sneakers where dress codes allow) help with long commutes and full workdays.

faqs.question: How do I keep a capsule wardrobe suitable for both office and dinner?
faqs.answer: Choose neutral, well-fitted pieces and elevate them with one polished layer, structured accessories, or simple jewelry so the outfit transitions easily after work.
